properties.displayName: CCC.Core.CN03 - AKS clusters must disable local accounts
properties.description: Audits AKS managed clusters that do not disable local (static kubeconfig) accounts. Disabling local accounts forces all access through Microsoft Entra ID, where MFA / Conditional Access is enforced, instead of long-lived static credentials. Maps to FINOS CCC Core CN03 (Implement Multi-Factor Authentication) and enforces the AVM aks sample setting 'disable_local_accounts = true'.
